vul_knowledge.solution_behavior: To mitigate the vulnerability, it is necessary to restrict the maximum memory usage of the LZMA decoder to a reasonable limit. This can be achieved by setting a specific limit (e.g., 100,000,000 bytes) instead of using UINT64_MAX. This ensures that the decoder cannot consume more memory than intended, preventing excessive memory consumption and potential Denial of Service (DoS) attacks.
